connector.name: Ghl MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: GoHighLevel CRM for AI agents. 60+ tools for contacts, messaging, calendars, and payments.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ghl-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the northrosetech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GHL_API_KEY
env.description: GoHighLevel Private Integration Token. Create at: GHL Settings → Private Integrations → Create New Integration.

env.name: GHL_LOCATION_ID
env.description: GoHighLevel sub-account (location) ID. Visible in the URL when viewing a sub-account.

env.name: GHL_BASE_URL
env.description: GHL API base URL. The default works for all standard installs.

env.name: GHL_API_VERSION
env.description: Value for the GHL API Version header.

env.name: TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' for Claude Desktop / Claude Code, 'http' for N8N and remote clients.
